characters.description: Founder of the Atwood Empire and a dual human-Draugr cultivator. Stranded in the Void Star with Ogras and Vi, Zac seeks a way out.
characters.name: Zac

characters.description: Zac’s demon companion, believed lost after vanishing into a spatial vortex.
characters.name: Ogras

characters.description: Zac's spiritual plant companion.
characters.name: Vivi

characters.description: The consciousness associated with Zac's coffin-like spirit tool.
characters.name: Alea

characters.description: A Voidgate researcher and spatial guide traveling with Zac and Ogras. She seeks rescue from the compromised realm.
characters.name: Vi

characters.description: Zac's Titan-blooded ally from Earth. He rules a local kingdom with the support of its realm spirit.
characters.name: Billy

characters.description: The lipless, heart-cursed commander of an invading Kantanu force.
characters.name: Kantanu commander

characters.description: Zac's sister, who is alive but held through their mother Leandra's connection to the Six Profundity Empire.
characters.name: Kenzie

characters.description: Zac and Kenzie's mother. She took Kenzie into the orbit of the Six Profundity Empire.
characters.name: Leandra

characters.description: The sentient spirit of the dimensional-seed realm. Corruption has made her dangerously ill, and saving her may require remaking most of her domain.
characters.name: Jemmy

characters.description: Billy's statue-like mentor, who proposes remaking Jemmy's realm to save her. In return, the mentor requires Billy to open a portal, seek its true body, and stay away from Ultum.
characters.name: Statue-like mentor

characters.description: A powerful Voidgate spatial cultivator and Vi's niece. She helps organize the defense of Jemmy's realm and the difficult plan to evacuate its residents.
characters.name: Layara

characters.description: An Albright Empire fighter aiding the defenders of Jemmy’s realm.
characters.name: Pretty

characters.description: A formidable fire cultivator pursuing Zac. Her arrival disrupts the siege.
characters.name: Iz Tayn

characters.description: Iz Tayn's independent fire golem and battlefield companion. Its power dominates the local fighting as it moves to rejoin her.
characters.name: Kvalk

characters.description: A gigantic runic guardian emerging from the corrupted lake. A fragment of the Lost Plane gateway is embedded as its ninth eye, shielding it and feeding its strength.
characters.name: Qriz’Ul King

characters.description: A Vigil-linked leader who separates Zac from his companions and explains the altered Left Imperial Palace contest and its coming war condition.
characters.name: Void Priestess

characters.description: Zac’s disciple and an axe-array cultivator.
characters.name: Emily

characters.description: Zac’s Draugr ally and contact within the Undead Empire.
characters.name: Catheya

characters.description: Zac’s spectral butler and an educator in Elysium.
characters.name: Triv

characters.description: An Atwood commander and spear specialist.
characters.name: Joanna

characters.description: An Atwood leader and revenant commander.
characters.name: Velary

characters.description: An undead ally of Zac.
characters.name: Ruger

characters.description: A key Atwood Empire administrator who suppresses insurrections and wrote the Atwood Codex. She expects undead integration to create further unrest.
characters.name: Julia Lombard

characters.description: Leader of the Zhix and a cautious possible recruit for Zac's inheritance search. He weighs opportunities for his people against the political consequences of closer cooperation.
characters.name: Rubot

characters.description: A Jix breeder and discovery-oriented cultivator. Zac invites him to the Million Gates expedition because his outlook and abilities may prove useful around ancient inheritances.
characters.name: Ibtep

characters.description: Zac's covert political adviser. He recommends stopping organized opposition to undead integration before it can spread, while maintaining a different public posture.
characters.name: Henry Marshall

characters.description: A figure whose unresolved bond with the Ayn Hive Queen prompts Velary to ask Zac to monitor her.
characters.name: Lily

characters.description: A captive sword cultivator used in the Blessed Kin's experiments. She resists a corruptive elixir and refuses an order to kill children despite the consequences.
characters.name: Thea

characters.description: An early-monarch unorthodox alchemist who holds Thea as an experimental subject and studies her response to a corruptive elixir.
characters.name: Hallowed Mother

characters.description: A powerful traveling Buddhist cultivator who intervenes against the Hallowed Mother. He frees Thea and seeks to recruit her as a guide for a journey beyond Earth.
characters.name: Three Virtues

characters.description: A moon-spanning moss network awakened into consciousness by Integration. Unable to manage the growing life and death attunements around it, the entity demands that Zac provide a solution.
characters.name: Emerald Eye moss consciousness

characters.description: A fugitive technocrat navigator pursued by pirates after an Ultum opportunity draws attention to him. Ogras's force rescues him, then compels him to guide a raid.
characters.name: Jowl

characters.description: An Atwood archer defending the entrance to an ancient array tower during Ogras's expedition. He supports the battle from range while searchers work inside.
characters.name: Carl

characters.description: Carl's wife and a member of Ogras's expedition. She guards the entrance to an ancient tower while her husband provides ranged support against attacking pirates.
characters.name: Lissa

characters.description: An Undead Empire correspondent whose final-chapter message offers Zac supplies while cautioning him against taking appearances at face value.
characters.name: Laz Temzul

characters.description: Zac's established public undead identity, now openly confirmed to the Undead Empire delegation. The identity lets him operate politically among undead powers while concealing the full nature of his dual existence.
characters.name: Arcaz Black

characters.description: An inventor who awakens carrying the Realm Keeper orb, the Seal of the Mercurial Court. The inheritance names him a realm singer of Ultum, and he hopes to restore his lost wife.
characters.name: Mercurial Court realm singer
